title: Kal Ki Awaz
desc: When a bank chairman's son is abducted and held for ransom, DSP Ali intervenes but cannot save the child. Later, his world is turned upside down when his daughter is kidnapped.

title: Beti
desc: Sudha assumes a recent acquaintance is the man she's being asked to marry and agrees to the match. When she realises her mistake it's too late, and she has to choose between love and family honour.

title: Hasina Maan Jayegi
desc: Rakesh and Kamal, doppelgangers of one another, fall for the same woman, Archana. However, when their petty rivalry evolves into something more sinister, she must find her true love.

title: Hamraaz
desc: Kumar, a popular actor from Bombay, takes a trip to Darjeeling with his partner Shabhnam; while there, he meets and falls in love with Meena, the only daughter of a wealthy military contractor.
